summary: Unfold the correlation as an integral over G_f(T) × G_∞ of the product of the finite Bessel vector and the archimedean kernel; write the finite phases through unipotent characters (val), the sums over 𝖴 of the cutoffs as 1 (ex), identify the integrand with the coset-amplitude summands, and exchange sum and integral (absolute convergence from amplitudeAbs).

steps.claim: Introduce q, γ.
steps.lean: intro q γ

steps.claim: δ(u, u') = uγu'⁻¹.
steps.lean: let δ (x : besselU × besselU) := x.1.1 * γ * x.2.1⁻¹

steps.claim: B(c, x, u, y) = β_c(u_∞y) if h_c⁻¹uh_c·x ∈ K(g), else 0.
steps.lean:
let B c x u y :=
    ite (S.termPosition c c u * x ∈ S.principalLevel) (S.classCutoff c (S.ratToInf u * y)) 0

steps.claim: val: if x is integral outside T and h_c⁻¹uh_c·x ∈ K(g), then phase(g, x_T) = unipotentChar(ratToFin(u))⁻¹.
steps.lean:
have val {c} {u : besselU} {x} (t : S.IsIntegralOff T x) (h :
    S.termPosition c c u * x ∈ S.principalLevel) : P.phase F.g (S.toPlaces T x) =
    (S.unipotentChar (S.ratToFin u.1))⁻¹ := eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right (by
    obtain ⟨⟨d, h⟩, j⟩ := hF.mem_principalLevel_iff.1 h, u.2.termPosition_mem_besselU c
    rw [unipotentChar_eq_of_mem_principalLevel j (ratToFin_mem_besselU.2 u.2) c.out
      (by simp [termPosition, mul_assoc]), ← hF.psi_simpleRootSum_eq_unipotentChar
      ((mul_mem_cancel_right t).1 d), ← P.phase_besselU_mul (j.map_mem_unitriangularOn _),
      P.phase_eq (one_mem _) (by simpa using h)]; simp [simpleRootSum_eq_zero_of_mem_besselH])

steps.claim: ex: if x is integral outside T and phase(g, x_T) ≠ 0, then Σ_{u∈𝖴(E)} B(c, x, u, y) = 1.
steps.lean:
have ex {c x} (t : S.IsIntegralOff T x) (h : P.phase F.g (S.toPlaces T x) ≠ 0) y : ∑' u : besselU,
    B c x u.1 y = 1 := by
    have ⟨u, hu, h⟩ := P.exists_besselU_of_phase_ne_zero h; obtain ⟨u, rfl, s, d⟩ :=
      exists_toPlaces_eq u
    obtain ⟨v, hv, d, -⟩ := exists_rat_approx_unipotentChar_eq c (d.1 hu)
    erw [← tsum_classCutoff_eq_one c ((S.ratToInf v)⁻¹ * y), tsum_subtype _ (B c x · y),
      tsum_subtype _ (S.classCutoff c <|
      S.ratToInf · * _), ← (Equiv.mulRight v⁻¹).tsum_eq]; congr with w
    simp [indicator, B, classUnip, mul_mem_cancel_right, hv, termPosition, mul_assoc, ite_and, by
      simpa [termPosition, mul_assoc] using
        mul_mem_cancel_right (y := S.termPosition c c w) (mul_mem (inv_mem d)
      (by simp [hF.mem_principalLevel_iff, IsIntegralOff, mul_mem, *] : u⁻¹ * x ∈ _))]
steps.typed_fact:
∑' u : besselU,
    B c x u.1 y = 1

steps.claim: u ∈ 𝖴 with u⁻¹x_T ∈ K(g), lifted to a global u,
steps.lean:
have ⟨u, hu, h⟩ := P.exists_besselU_of_phase_ne_zero h; obtain ⟨u, rfl, s, d⟩ :=
      exists_toPlaces_eq u

steps.claim: a rational approximation v with the same character,
steps.lean: obtain ⟨v, hv, d, -⟩ := exists_rat_approx_unipotentChar_eq c (d.1 hu)

steps.claim: and Σ_w β_c(w_∞ v_∞⁻¹ y) = 1 reindexed by v.
steps.lean:
erw [← tsum_classCutoff_eq_one c ((S.ratToInf v)⁻¹ * y), tsum_subtype _ (B c x · y),
      tsum_subtype _ (S.classCutoff c <|
      S.ratToInf · * _), ← (Equiv.mulRight v⁻¹).tsum_eq]; congr with w

steps.claim: The conditions match termwise: for w ∈ 𝖴, termPosition(c, c, w)·x ∈ K(g) iff w·v⁻¹ ∈ classUnip(c) (through the approximation v and mul_mem_cancel_right), so each term of ∑_w B(c, x, w, y) is the corresponding cutoff term.
steps.lean:
simp [indicator, B, classUnip, mul_mem_cancel_right, hv, termPosition, mul_assoc, ite_and, by
      simpa [termPosition, mul_assoc] using
        mul_mem_cancel_right (y := S.termPosition c c w) (mul_mem (inv_mem d)
      (by simp [hF.mem_principalLevel_iff, IsIntegralOff, mul_mem, *] : u⁻¹ * x ∈ _))]

steps.claim: Q(x): the pair (u, u') is admissible (h_c⁻¹uh_c integral off T and δ ∈ termsOver(c, reduction(k), c')).
steps.lean: let Q x := S.IsIntegralOff T (S.termPosition c c x.1) ∧ δ x ∈ S.termsOver c (S.reduction k) c'

steps.claim: h(x, y) = [Q(x)]·β_cβ_c'·K(δ(x), y).
steps.lean:
let h x y := ite (Q x) ((S.classCutoff c y * S.classCutoff c' ((S.ratToInf (δ x))⁻¹ * y)).toReal •
    S.besselKernel (δ x) y) 0

steps.claim: g(x) = h(x, u_∞·) on the set where toPlaces(h_c⁻¹uh_c)·(·) ∈ congGroup(F).
steps.lean:
let g x := (((S.toPlaces T (S.termPosition c c x.1) * ·) ⁻¹' F.congGroup) ×ˢ univ).indicator
    fun w ↦ h x (S.ratToInf x.1 * w.2)

steps.claim: Unfold the correlation; identify w_q·(…) with toPlaces(termPosition(γ)),
steps.lean: rw [Level.correlation,

steps.claim: by termPosition_floorGroup_spec;
steps.lean:
show weylElem 𝔰.ϱ q * _ = S.toPlaces T (S.termPosition c c'
    γ) by simp [γ, termPosition_floorGroup_spec u c]; ext : 3; simp [toPlaces, U.map, weylElem,
    weylOn, apply_ite (evalPlaces T), -star_algebraMap_finAdele, -Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]; rfl,
steps.typed_fact:
weylElem 𝔰.ϱ q * _ = S.toPlaces T (S.termPosition c c'
    γ

steps.claim: write cosetAmplitude as a sum and each term as an integral of g(x) over K(g) × G_∞.
steps.lean:
PiLp.smul_apply, smul_assoc, cosetAmplitude, ← tsum_const_smul'',
    tsum_congr (g := (∫ w, g · w ∂F.groupMeasure.prod volume)) fun x ↦ by
    rw [integral_indicator ((measurable_const_mul _ P.measurableSet_unitaryLevel).prod .univ),
      ← Measure.restrict_prod_eq_prod_univ, integral_fun_snd (h x <| _ * ·),
      integral_mul_left_eq_self]; split <;> simp [h, Q, amplitude, δ, Measure.real, *]]

steps.claim: Integral of an indicator of a product set; left invariance; the cases of Q.
steps.lean:
rw [integral_indicator ((measurable_const_mul _ P.measurableSet_unitaryLevel).prod .univ),
      ← Measure.restrict_prod_eq_prod_univ, integral_fun_snd (h x <| _ * ·),
      integral_mul_left_eq_self]; split <;> simp [h, Q, amplitude, δ, Measure.real, *]]

steps.claim: Exchange sum and integral coordinatewise (integrability of the indicators).
steps.lean:
congr 1 with i; rw [tsum_integral_apply fun x ↦ .indicator (by unfold h; split <;> fun_prop)
    ((measurable_const_mul _ P.measurableSet_unitaryLevel).prod .univ)]

steps.claim: Compare the integrands at (z, y): lift z to x integral off T;
steps.lean:
· simp [besselCorrelation]; rw [← integral_mul_right_eq_self _ a.out.1, ← integral_prod_mul]
    congr with ⟨z, y⟩; obtain ⟨x, rfl, t, -⟩ := exists_toPlaces_eq z
    let ξ := (S.termPosition c c' γ)⁻¹ * x * k
    have s : ξ.1 ∈ _ := mul_mem (mul_mem (inv_mem o) t) (mem_latStabilizer_iff.1 k.2).1
    have C w : S.toPlaces T (S.termPosition c c w.1) * S.toPlaces T x ∈ F.congGroup ∧ Q w ↔
      S.termPosition c c w.1 * x ∈ S.principalLevel ∧ S.termPosition c' c' w.2 * ξ ∈
      S.principalLevel := and_assoc.symm.trans (.trans (and_congr_left' (by
      simp [hF.mem_principalLevel_iff, mul_mem_cancel_right t, IsIntegralOff, and_comm]))
      (and_congr_right fun ⟨l, L⟩ ↦ by
      clear * - L
      use .imp' (·⁻¹ * l * k) ?_,
        .imp' (l * k * ·⁻¹) ?_ <;> simp_all [δ, ξ, termPosition, mul_assoc]))
    have j := P.phase_mul_of_mem_unitaryLevel (y := S.toPlaces T ξ) e
    set r : ℂ := _ * _; conv_lhs at j => simp [ξ, mul_assoc]
    rw [tsum_congr (g := fun w ↦
      (B c x w.1 y * B c' ξ w.2 ((S.ratToInf γ)⁻¹ * y)).toReal • r) fun w ↦ by
      simp [h, B, δ, indicator, ← ite_and, C, ↓ite_zero_mul_ite_zero]; split_ifs with q
      simp [↓besselKernel_besselU_mul, val t q.1, val s q.2, r,
        Level.IntermediateGroup.besselVector, j, besselKernel, mul_assoc, unipotentChar,
        inv_eq_conj]; simp]
    by_cases r = 0; simp [*]
    simp_all [↓tsum_toReal_smul_of_tsum_eq_one, r, Level.IntermediateGroup.besselVector, mul_assoc]

steps.claim: ξ = termPosition(γ)⁻¹·x·k;
steps.lean: let ξ := (S.termPosition c c' γ)⁻¹ * x * k

steps.claim: ξ is integral off T;
steps.lean: have s : ξ.1 ∈ _ := mul_mem (mul_mem (inv_mem o) t) (mem_latStabilizer_iff.1 k.2).1

steps.claim: C: the admissibility condition for (u, u') is equivalent to the two level conditions for x and ξ;
steps.lean:
have C w : S.toPlaces T (S.termPosition c c w.1) * S.toPlaces T x ∈ F.congGroup ∧ Q w ↔
      S.termPosition c c w.1 * x ∈ S.principalLevel ∧ S.termPosition c' c' w.2 * ξ ∈
      S.principalLevel := and_assoc.symm.trans (.trans (and_congr_left' (by
      simp [hF.mem_principalLevel_iff, mul_mem_cancel_right t, IsIntegralOff, and_comm]))
      (and_congr_right fun ⟨l, L⟩ ↦ by
      clear * - L
      use .imp' (·⁻¹ * l * k) ?_,
        .imp' (l * k * ·⁻¹) ?_ <;> simp_all [δ, ξ, termPosition, mul_assoc]))
steps.typed_fact:
S.toPlaces T (S.termPosition c c w.1) * S.toPlaces T x ∈ F.congGroup ∧ Q w ↔
      S.termPosition c c w.1 * x ∈ S.principalLevel ∧ S.termPosition c' c' w.2 * ξ ∈
      S.principalLevel

steps.claim: j: phase(g, ξ_T) is unchanged by the coset condition e;
steps.lean: have j := P.phase_mul_of_mem_unitaryLevel (y := S.toPlaces T ξ) e

steps.claim: Let r be the product of the two phase factors; simplify j (the phase of ξ at T).
steps.lean: set r : ℂ := _ * _; conv_lhs at j => simp [ξ, mul_assoc]

steps.claim: each term equals B(c, x, u, y)·B(c', ξ, u', γ⁻¹y)·r with r the product of phases (val, besselKernel_besselU_mul),
steps.lean:
rw [tsum_congr (g := fun w ↦
      (B c x w.1 y * B c' ξ w.2 ((S.ratToInf γ)⁻¹ * y)).toReal • r) fun w ↦ by
      simp [h, B, δ, indicator, ← ite_and, C, ↓ite_zero_mul_ite_zero]; split_ifs with q
      simp [↓besselKernel_besselU_mul, val t q.1, val s q.2, r,
        Level.IntermediateGroup.besselVector, j, besselKernel, mul_assoc, unipotentChar,
        inv_eq_conj]; simp]

steps.claim: and if r ≠ 0 the sums of B are 1 (ex).
steps.lean:
by_cases r = 0; simp [*]
    simp_all [↓tsum_toReal_smul_of_tsum_eq_one, r, Level.IntermediateGroup.besselVector, mul_assoc]

steps.claim: Absolute convergence: bounded by the absolute amplitudes (finite) times 𝖬(K) < ∞ (injectivity of δ).
steps.lean:
grw [← mul_lt_top ((amplitudeAbs_lt_top_and_cut_le univ c _).1 c').2
    (hF.groupMeasure_ne_top P.unitaryLevel_le_unitaryLevel_one).lt_top, tsum_subtype,
    ← tsum_comp_le_tsum_of_injective fun _ _ e ↦ (big_cell_unique u e).2, ← ENNReal.tsum_mul_right]

steps.claim: Termwise, the norm of an indicator is the indicator of the norm.
steps.lean: gcongr with x; simp [enorm_indicator_eq_indicator_enorm]

steps.claim: integral of the indicator ≤ product of integrals;
steps.lean: grw [lintegral_indicator_le, ← Measure.prod_restrict, lintegral_prod_le]

steps.claim: Left invariance of the Haar measure at infinity: ∫ ‖h(x, u_∞w)‖ dw = ∫ ‖h(x, w)‖ dw.
steps.lean: simp [lintegral_mul_left_eq_self (‖h x ·‖ₑ)]

steps.claim: and |β·K| bound by the absolute amplitude.
steps.lean: unfold h; split_ifs with q; grw [enorm_toReal_smul_le, indicator_of_mem q.2, amplitudeAbs]; simp
